question: Does exact adaptive mixed-tail grouping improve the nine frozen native large-gesture masks with unchanged 64-record submission in warm and idle A/B/A?

parameters.one_factor: Mixed-model tails only when the immutable context metadata saves at least one eighth of original groups. Geometry/product labels and scientific values are not used. All other kernel/submission/loading policies unchanged.
parameters.default: false; isolated internal flag only; no app/public API change
parameters.environment: QUANTEM_TANS_REPLAY_MIXED_TAILS=1 QUANTEM_TANS_MIXED_SAVINGS_DIVISOR=8 QUANTEM_TANS_REPLAY_BASE_SPLIT=64; HOLD_IDLE_SECONDS0or4; HOLD_CYCLES3or2. B_mixed only changes grouping, not submission/residency.
parameters.matrix: Nine held-out frozen native geometries/histories and 198 probes per query; warm N3/case/arm81queries and4-second-idle N2/case/arm54queries; A/B/A; separate processes. All arms64records/command to match current QA app. Repeat loading on each process, sourcepage state unspecified.
parameters.preflight: 4/4 independent focused tests pass, including full uint16 literal, escaped symbols, 91-zero-pair chains, mixed model IDs, inactive lanes and signed removal. Initial compiler type-check timeout retained and fixed with explicit UInt32 closure type.
parameters.gate: Frozen Linux BF/ADF/ABF full images, full66 hashes against default, immutable prior, group/lane counters and memory. Independent full original-count audit remains pending.
parameters.timing: Whole query through completion wait; preparation separate; prepared archive/source pages unspecified; not native FPS or original cold load
parameters.memory: Same source/index/table/scientific scratch; collect Metal allocation and sampled RSS/compressor/swap

artifact_results.raw: All exact query records; not native FPS

parameters.decision: Promising gains but refuted as blanket app default due efficient-case regression; preserve and isolate dispatch specialization.
